definitions.explanation: Tools and implements used for preparing and cooking food, such as knives, pots, pans, and spatulas.

examples.japanese: {調理器具|ちょうりきぐ}を{洗|あら}う。
{新|あたら}しい{調理器具|ちょうりきぐ}を{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to buy new cooking utensils.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}は{特別|とくべつ}な{調理器具|ちょうりきぐ}がなくても{簡単|かんたん}に{作|つく}れる。
examples.english: This dish can be easily made without any special cooking utensils.

notes:
USAGE:
{調理器具|ちょうりきぐ} is a general term covering all tools used in food preparation. It is commonly used in recipes, product descriptions, and cooking instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調理器具|ちょうりきぐ}を{揃|そろ}える (to get a set of cooking utensils)
- {調理器具|ちょうりきぐ}{売|う}り{場|ば} (kitchenware section/department)
- {調理器具|ちょうりきぐ}の{手入|てい}れ (maintenance of cooking tools)

RELATED WORDS:
- {包丁|ほうちょう}: kitchen knife
- {鍋|なべ}: pot
- {食器|しょっき}: tableware, dishes
